name: Tanados UI
description: Tanados UI rebrands Jellyfin Web automatically with the Tanados logo/colors and adds the enhanced MonWUI/JMSFusion experience layer.
overview: Tanados-branded Jellyfin Web UI upgrade with automatic logo replacement, purple/gold theme accents, cinematic sliders, enhanced details, playback, profiles, watchlist, and settings.

versions.changelog:
v2.9.0.1

Hotfixes:
- Added lightweight browser smoke coverage for login branding, embedded settings mount, and upcoming home/top-nav injection
- Cleaned up the TrailerAutomationService async warning so release builds complete without the previous CS1998 warning
- Preserved the Tanados UI 2.9.0.0 rebrand, localization, calendar, branding, and audio badge changes in the packaged release

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded
